projects.name: Global Game Jam 2026 Project
projects.description: Godot project created in a 48-hour time limit. Jump around on a grid collecting coins while avoiding enemy statues under the watchful eye of the Game Master.

projects.name: Bowling Tournament Project
projects.description: ASP.NET application using MVC-Framework and an SQLite database. Allows registration of Teams and Players with separate layers of access for unlogged users and administrators. Created in partnership with Sheila Kazvini and Lincoln Tozer.

projects.name: Social Media Website
projects.description: PHP web application using an SQL database. Includes features to sign up, log in, create posts and follow other users. Your home page is populated with the most recent posts from people you follow.

projects.name: VHS Rental Application
projects.description: Online store that integrates object-oriented programming principles. You can create, read, and edit items to a CSV text file, as well as log in to separate accounts and submit items to checkout. Created in partnership with Lincoln Tozer.

projects.name: Responsive Web Country History
projects.description: A website showcasing various parts of American history that integrates responsive web design principles. Has a navigation submenu, lots of styling, all the good stuff. Created in partnership with Lincoln Tozer.

projects.name: This Portfolio
projects.description: Written in my own time, using lots of CSS and JavaScript programming.

projects.name: Restaurant Menu
projects.description: CRUD app for a restaurant. Uses React for the front-end, Express for the back-end, and Mongo for the database to hold all of the menu items. Allows CRUD-operations

projects.name: Pepperoni Pizza Shop
projects.description: Written in Java using Spring. Supports CRUD operations for creating pizzas with different ingredients, as well as logging in and out.
